findings.title: Masking strips hostname role hints (DC/CA), degrading tier-zero priority
findings.detail: v1-vs-v2 judged eval: v2 scored 11 (cross-host) and 13 (timeline) vs v1's 17/20 because pseudonymizing ALDC02->Hostname7 destroys the 'domain controller' signal carried by the name. Privacy win, correctness regression on tier-zero questions.

findings.title: No temperature/seed control on Codex -> irreducible run-to-run variance
findings.detail: Codex subscription CLI exposes no temperature/seed; A4 confirmed runtime==eval transport (codex-subscription/gpt-5.6-sol), so the live 0-step is genuine sampling variance. Quantified by Track B give-up rate.
findings.repro: same question yields 0 vs 2+ tool steps across repeats (Track B)

findings.title: Masking is best-effort: an identifier only inside a raw evidence row can leak unmasked
findings.detail: _build_mask_mapping is graph-derived; a value present only in a raw row (not an entity) may not be in the mapping and reaches the provider. Acknowledged in investigate.py docstring.
findings.repro: raw row contains a hostname absent from graph entities
